(12)[.][.][.][.][.][.][.][.]ḫ?mlol : (13)solkete (14)nyrdoke(15)l : ḫyle (16)l?yiidote (17)n?likte : k?mo(18)rleb : kesetoleb : (19)yoel?m?n?e as?o?l?(20)to?etowi :
notes: No line number 1 printed. Line 5: after ted?ḫ the copy has a row of 18 short slanting strokes plus one short tick by the hatched w, written as 19 [.] (strokes taken as traces of lost signs, one per stroke; the count is mine). Line 12: 8 such strokes, written as 8 [.]. 'qowi' (lines 3 and elsewhere): visual '3//' read as q (3 with slash) + o; could be m/s + y. y in this copy is mostly two strokes '//'. Line 4 'bose?': sign before e is an open 3 (s, m or ẖ). Line 6 first sign is an L-shaped stroke ending in a loop, read to (same form as to in 'ato', line 10); the next sign is a small hooked sign read l (could be i). Line 11 'ps?o?se?': after p a hatched '/3' (s+o or q), then a hatched cup with strokes (se? or ḫ?). Line 12 first sign after the gap: c with a bar, hatched (ḫ?). Line 13 'solkete': '/3' read s+o (could be q). Line 14: 'n' is a large ʌ-form with long tail; '//' read y. Line 15 'ḫyle': the first slash touches the c. Line 16: first sign hatched (l?), then '//' (y), two joined 4-forms (i i). Line 17: n? is a small ℛ-like sign (n or d). Line 17-18: first sign hatched ξ with long tail (k or p); then 3 with tail (m) and slash (o); '/3' could also be q. Line 19: two hatched signs (l?, n?) around a 3 (m?). Line 19-20: after a, a hatched 3 with slash (s+o or q), a hatched 4-form (l?), then a slanting L-stroke with foot under (20) read to? (could be te). k and p (both ξ/ʒ with long tail) settled by context in psiẖte/kete.

caption: Kar. 26. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 16, No. 7093)
notes: Line 3: the sign after treyi is a ʎ-form with a hook (n? or d). 'qowi' read as in Kar. 25 ('3//' = q + o). Line 4: ñ is a loop over two spread legs (ꭓ-form); the sign after t has a short dash before it (l, or a second t); i? is hatched; one sign's width of hatching before the divider = [.]. Line 5: te hatched at the bar. Line 6 opening '33/': read s + s + o; '/3' could be q (sqr). One hatched blob with nothing readable = [.]. m? is a 3 with short tail (m, s or ẖ). n is '/3' with a long tail (ℛ-form). Line 7: s? is an open 3; se? is a cup with ONE slash on its left (se is elsewhere cup + two slashes on the right), so uncertain; the ñ is an X with a loop. k in lines 8-9 is a 3 with a long tail.

caption: Kar. 27. Altar
reading: wo?si : (2)soreyi : (3)qon?tqowi : ate?p?ldemo : yetm(4)delo : sen?te : yetmdelowi : m?(5)tt?dese : yerwñodetel : m?dl?ḫ(6)wi : tm?de(7)ye : (8)tedḫel?(9)o : mlom?(10)rl?wi : a?to mẖe : psiẖ(11)te : at mẖe : psiḫrk?e(12)te : ḫmlol : oiidote n?ilk(13)te : m?lo(14)lowi :
notes: Line 1: o of wosi hatched. Line 3: both 3-forms with slashes read q + o ('qo'), could be m/s + y; n? is a rising stroke into a 2-form without long tail. Line 4 'ate?p?ldemo': after a a slash + 4-form with bar (te, or o + l), then a reversed ξ with long tail (p or k). The divider after 'demo' is partly hatched. 'sente': se is cup + slashes, n is ℛ with long tail. Line 5: the (5) stands just left of the first sign (an open 3, m?), so placed after it; then two dotted ϟ-forms (t t?), d, e, se. 'yerwñodetel': the slash before the te cross may be o (then 'o te l' / 'otel'). Line 6: m? is a 3 with dots, l? a blotted hooked sign. Line 7: 'tm?de' 3 with long lower-left tail (m or ẖ). Line 8-9: the sign before (9)o is a small open 5-form like the e before it: l or e. Line 10: m? and l? (hatched 4-form) uncertain. Line 10 'a?to': a is drawn as a 5 plus a separate hatched tailed sign; to is the L-form with dot. Line 12 'psiḫrkete': ḫ? is a ᒐ-form; k? is a 3 with long tail (k or p). Line 13: 'oii' = one slash and two joined 4-forms (cf. Kar. 25 line 16 'yii'); n? a small ꝛ-form. Line 14: m? is a 3-form.
